Are you tired of financial noise and bias market commentary?
I'm Justin Klein. And I'm Lou Guerrero. We are wealth managers with KPP Financial and the hosts of the Daily Investing Podcast, Invest Talk.
Every weekday, we cut through the chatter to bring you unbiased financial education and answers to your burning questions. whether we are breaking down complex macroeconomic trends, analyzing specific stocks and ETFs, or helping you optimize your 401k. Our goal is to help you become a better investor.
And the best part, you drive the show. No investment question is off limits. You can call our 24-7 voice bank at 888-99 chart to have your specific stock ticker or portfolio strategy analyzed live on air.
Join a community of investors who trust our daily guidance. A community that has helped us reach over 60 million downloads.
If you want actionable strategies to navigate inflation, global economic shifts, and everyday market volatility, hit the follow button right now here on Spotify. We drop new episodes every single weekday.
Follow on Vestock today, and let's make smarter financial decisions together.
